svg.text: through the axis and the sensor drill
1. Stainless steel, same alloy as the body (304 quoted; 316L alternative).
2. Turn the dome, closure shoulder and male M30×1.5 spigot. Bore the Ø24.5 counterbore
and the flat-bottomed Ø11.1 motor pocket.
3. Drill the Ø2.5 sensor hole with a live tool, offset 7.8 from the axis, 12.5 deep with
a 140° point; 1 mm nominal web to the motor pocket.
4. Motor: NFP-E1015, Ø11 ±0.1 × 26 mm can, seated on the pocket floor. Pocket fit to the
received motors is not yet set.
5. The closure shoulder seats metal-to-metal on the body face; it sets the O-ring
squeeze. Keep it flat and free of burrs.
6. Polish the dome. Protect the thread and the closure shoulder.
7. Thread shown as the basic-root envelope, not teeth. Tolerances to be agreed with the
Turned cap: motor pocket, offset sensor drill, M30×1.5 spigot
